sprite.name: Sprite
sprite.description: An animated object that is the building block of most projects.

edit-animations.name: Animations
edit-animations.desc: Click to edit the object's animations.

make-original-size.name: Size
make-original-size.desc: Click to set the object to the same size as its image.

initially-visible.name: Initially visible
initially-visible.desc: Choose whether the object is visible when the layout starts.

enable-collisions.name: Enable collisions
enable-collisions.desc: Whether the object will register collision events or not.

live-preview.name: Preview
live-preview.desc: Tick to run a live preview in the editor.

is-animation-playing.description: Test which of the object's animations is currently playing.

animation.name: Animation
animation.desc: Enter the name of the animation to check if playing.

compare-animation-frame.description: Test which animation frame is currently showing.

comparison.name: Comparison
comparison.desc: How to compare the current animation frame number (0-based).

number.name: Number
number.desc: The animation frame number to compare to (0-based).

compare-animation-frame-tag.description: Compare against the current animation frame's tag.

comparison.name: Comparison
comparison.desc: How to compare the current animation frame's tag.

tag.name: tag
tag.desc: The animation frame tag to compare against.

on-animation-finished.description: Triggered when an animation has finished.

animation.name: Animation
animation.desc: Enter the name of the animation that has finished.

on-any-animation-finished.description: Triggered when any animation has finished.

on-animation-frame-changed.description: Triggered when the current animation frame changes.

comparison.name: Comparison
comparison.desc: How to compare the current animation speed.

number.name: Number
number.desc: The animation speed to compare to.

is-mirrored.description: True if the object has been mirrored with the 'Set Mirrored' action.

is-flipped.description: True if the object has been flipped with the 'Set Flipped' action.

collisions-enabled.description: True if the object's collisions are enabled and will fire collision events.

on-image-url-loaded.description: Triggered after 'Load image from URL' when the image has finished loading.

on-image-url-failed.display-text: On image URL failed to load
on-image-url-failed.description: Triggered after 'Load image from URL' if the image fails to load.

stop-animation.description: Stop the current animation from playing.

start-animation.description: Start the current animation, if it was stopped.

from.name: From
from.desc: Choose whether to resume or rewind the animation back to the first frame.

animation.name: Animation
animation.desc: The name of the animation to set.

from.name: From
from.desc: Choose whether to play from the same frame number or rewind the animation back to the first frame.

set-animation-frame.description: Set the current animation frame by its index or tag.

frame-number.name: Frame
frame-number.desc: The animation frame index (0-based), or a string of the frame tag.

speed.name: Speed
speed.desc: The new animation speed, in animation frames per second.

set-repeat-to-frame.description: Set the animation frame number to repeat to in a looping animation.

frame-number.name: Frame number
frame-number.desc: The animation frame number to repeat to (0-based).

add-remove-animation.description: Add or remove an animation in the object.

which.name: Which
which.desc: Whether to add a new animation or remove an existing animation.

name.name: Name
name.desc: The animation name to add or remove.

add-remove-animation-frame.description: Add or remove an animation frame in the current animation.

which.name: Which
which.desc: Whether to add a new animation frame or remove an existing animation frame.

animation.name: Animation
animation.desc: The name of the animation to modify.

where.name: Where
where.desc: The index or tag at which to insert or delete an animation frame. Use -1 for last frame.

set-blend-mode.description: Set the background blend mode for this object.

blend-mode.name: Blend mode
blend-mode.desc: Choose the new blend mode for this object.

set-mirrored.description: Set the object horizontally mirrored or back to normal.

state.name: State
state.desc: Choose whether to horizontally mirror the object or set it back to normal.

set-flipped.description: Set the object vertically flipped or back to normal.

state.name: State
state.desc: Choose whether to vertically flip the object or set it back to normal.

spawn-another-object.display-text: Spawn {0} on layer [b]{1}[/b] (image point [i]{2}[/i], create hierarchy: [i]{3}[/i], template: [i]{4}[/i])
spawn-another-object.description: Create another object at this object.

object.name: Object
object.desc: Choose the object type of the new instance to create.

layer.name: Layer
layer.desc: The layer name or number to create the instance on.

image-point.name: Image point
image-point.desc: Use 0 for the object's origin, or the name or number of an image point to spawn the object from.

create-hierarchy.name: Create hierarchy
create-hierarchy.desc: Whether to also create all child instances according to the hierarchy in the Layout View.

template-name.name: Template name
template-name.desc: Use a specific instance as a template when spawning a new object.

set-collisions-enabled.description: Set whether the object will register collision events or not.

collisions.name: Collisions
collisions.desc: Whether to enable or disable collisions for this object.

set-solid-collision-filter.description: Use a list of tags to filter collisions with the 'Solid' behavior.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Use 'Inclusive' to only collide with solids with the given tags. Use 'Exclusive' to ignore solids with the given tags.

tags.name: Tags
tags.desc: A space-separated list of tags to filter collisions with.

set-scale.description: Set the width and height as a multiple of its original size.

scale.name: Scale
scale.desc: The object width and height to set, based on a multiple of its original dimensions, e.g. 1 = original size, 2 = double size, 0.5 = half size etc.

load-image-from-url.description: Replace the currently displaying animation frame with an image loaded from a web address or data URI.

uri.name: URI
uri.desc: Enter the URL on the web, or data URI, of an image to load.

size.name: Size
size.desc: Whether to resize the sprite to the size of the loaded image, or stretch it to the current size.

cross-origin.name: Cross-origin
cross-origin.desc: The cross-origin (CORS) mode to use for the request.

animationframecount.description: The number of animation frames in the current animation.

animationframetag.description: A string tag to identify an animation frame.

animationname.description: The name of the current animation.

animationspeed.description: The speed of the current animation, in animation frames per second.

originalanimationspeed.description: The original speed of the current animation as set in the Animations Editor, in animation frames per second.

imagewidth.description: The width of the current animation frame image, in pixels.

imageheight.description: The height of the current animation frame image, in pixels.

imagepointx.description: The X position of one of the object's image points.

imagepoint.name: ImagePoint
imagepoint.desc: Name or number of image point to get.

imagepointy.description: The Y position of one of the object's image points.

imagepoint.name: ImagePoint
imagepoint.desc: Name or number of image point to get.

imagepointz.description: The Z position of one of the object's image points.

imagepoint.name: ImagePoint
imagepoint.desc: Name or number of image point to get.

imagepointcount.description: The number of image points the current frame has.

poly-point-x-at.description: The X position of one of the object's collision polygon points.

index.name: Index
index.desc: Zero-based index of the collision poly point to get.

poly-point-y-at.description: The Y position of one of the object's collision polygon points.

index.name: Index
index.desc: Zero-based index of the collision poly point to get.

poly-point-count.description: The number of collision polygon points the current frame has.
